figures.alt: Illustration of two children crouching in a backyard with a magnifying glass, looking closely at a green leaf on the grass while a robin watches.
figures.caption: Scientists start by looking closely at what is really there.

figures.alt: Photo of two paper towels side by side on a tray. A dropper over each towel has just released one blue drop, so both towels get the same test.
figures.caption: A fair comparison: same dropper, same drop, two different towels. Only the towel is different.

figures.alt: Bar graph, Drops each towel held. Towel A 5 drops, Towel B 8 drops.
figures.caption: Towel A held 5 drops and Towel B held 8 drops. Same dropper, same amount: the towels are what is different.
